scientific_integrity: Originality concerns the all-path ordered-transition theorem, not the established conditional detection statistic or the elementary detection formula. Analytical proof establishes all n; exact finite experiments corroborate.
scientific_limitations: Independent homogeneous Bernoulli transmission on a finite path, single uniformly randomly located nonsentinel seed, unit deterministic edge crossing times. Conditional latency need not optimize detection probability. No independent audit; equivalent exponential-family ranking results elsewhere cannot be excluded.
title: Ordered optimal sentinel locations for conditional epidemic detection on paths
